sentence: ReqView Desktop shall start in less than 10s.
The very first time it shall start in less than 30s.
User shall be able to work with documents up to 1000 objects.
User shall be able to work with documents up to 100 file attachments.
User shall be able to work with documents up to 100MB in size.
Response time for common edit operations (change attributes and structure) shall be less than 1s.
Opening or saving a local file shall took less than 10s.
Scrolling requirements table shall be smooth with jerks shorter than 200ms
Routine patching of the system shall be possible with minimal (i.e. less than 5 minutes) downtime.
Routine patching of the system shall be possible with no more than 1 hours downtime.
